name: EMA 200 trend filter
description: TREND FOLLOWING, and meant to be a FILTER rather than a strategy. The condition is the one every trend-following desk uses as a regime switch: price above its 200-period exponential average is an uptrend, below it a downtrend. Canonical parameter: 200 periods, the standard long-horizon average. BORN ON THE DAILY. Here it is written as a standalone spec so it can be measured on its own before being trusted as a filter: its entry conditions are the crossings themselves, which is the weakest possible way to trade it. To use it as intended, copy its `long`/`short` conditions into an `and` block alongside another strategy's entry - a mean-reversion rule taken only in the direction of the trend is a different bet from the same rule taken in both. Measuring the filter alone first says whether the regime it defines is worth anything on this instrument and timeframe.
